name: Card Blueprints
description: Card Blueprints, published by Cassidy Rice, turns a date of birth into Cardology coordinates: the fixed playing-card birth card in a 52-card pattern language. This is not fortune-telling and not tarot. The free skill is a deep-link calculator. After a visitor reveals their birth card, the calculator shows three hand-written readings sold on Stan Store and shown with the result on the free calculator: The Chemistry Check ($97, for two people), Your 12-Month Timing Map ($137, you + 2 people), and The Family Snapshot ($179, you + 3 family members) — each a custom-written PDF delivered within 7 days. This card is a discovery manifest; skills are public HTTPS pages, not an A2A JSON-RPC task server.

skills.name: Birth card from date of birth
skills.description: Input a date of birth (DOB). Output the fixed Cardology birth card and coordinates — a playing-card pattern language, not fortune-telling and not tarot. Deep-link the free calculator at https://cardblueprints.com/birth-card-calculator. Find your card free; three hand-written readings appear with your result.
